failure_modes.mode: Coil blockage due to precipitate formation
failure_modes.cause: Electrophilic aromatic substitution products or salts have low solubility in the industrial solvent at 60°C, leading to crystallization in the 0.75 mm ID coil
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement online UV-Vis monitoring for turbidity; add co-solvent or adjust concentration to maintain solubility margin >20%

failure_modes.mode: BPR failure leading to pressure surge
failure_modes.cause: Back Pressure Regulator (BPR) set at 3.0 bar but operating at 0.29 bar; if BPR sticks closed or fails to open, pressure can rise rapidly if pump continues, risking coil rupture or leak
failure_modes.mitigation: Install a secondary safety relief valve set at 1.5 bar; implement pressure interlock to stop pump if dP > 1.0 bar

failure_modes.mode: Incomplete quenching due to mixing inefficiency
failure_modes.cause: Enhanced laminar mixing regime (Re=16) may not achieve rapid quenching required for EAS reactions, leading to over-reaction or side products if quench zone is too short
failure_modes.mitigation: Validate quench efficiency with tracer study; increase quench coil length or use static mixer element post-reaction

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
Single pump failure — no redundancy for continuous operation
validation_experiments: Run reaction mixture at Q=0.56 mL/min for 10x residence time (188 min); monitor pressure for drift >10% indicating blockage
Perform quench efficiency test: inject pulse of reactant and measure conversion profile along coil to ensure >95% quench within 10 cm
Simulate BPR failure by manually blocking outlet; verify pressure relief valve activates at 1.5 bar and pump interlock stops flow
